verdict.rationale: Batch mode lets one job transcribe up to 10,000 files, or 1,000 from a manifest. Input can be an S3 prefix with glob include/exclude filters, and each transcript can be placed next to its input file. The full job lifecycle is documented: submit, list, status with per-state file counts, cancel, list files and get file. Files succeed or fail independently with PARTIAL job states, and a signed webhook fires on completion. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of large batch runs, and bulk operations beyond transcription (e.g., vocabulary assets are managed one at a time).
